user_intent: Get the Figma MCP server actually connected so the agent can read a Figma design file.
resolution: After attempts to call get_design_context failed (plugin skills present but no MCP server registered), the fix was adding {"mcpServers": {"figma": {"url": "https://mcp.figma.com/mcp"}}} to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, authenticating via Cursor Settings > MCP, and starting a new Agent chat since MCP servers don't attach to an already-open chat.
user_corrections: now you should be able to read this figma (after prior chat found MCP unconfigured)
